policy.identity: Same action, inputs, result and invariants is one canonical rule regardless of wording/game. Numbers, units and exceptions are profiles. Split composite source requirements; keep original wording/citation.
policy.completion: Every component of a composite binding must be covered. One rule can partially cover many games; never infer full-game support.
policy.evidence: Exact release SHA and validated profile; identical verified semantic profiles may reuse evidence across editions/games. Unknown parameters or incompatible exceptions block full propagation.
policy.scoring: Canonical implementation counted once; game breadth derived from compatible verified bindings. No duplicate points per game.
